tools.name: skilltrack_health
tools.title: MCP health
tools.description: Report whether the SkillTrack Labs MCP server is healthy: which tool groups are routed, whether mutations are permitted, and whether the cloud, gateway and database integrations are configured. Returns no tenant data.

tools.name: skilltrack_whoami
tools.title: Who am I
tools.description: Return the SkillTrack Labs identity behind this connection: display name, role, organisation and how many workspaces and labs are reachable. Use it to confirm the agent is connected as the right person before acting.

tools.name: skilltrack_list_labs
tools.title: List labs
tools.description: List the SkillTrack Labs labs this user can launch, with workspace, status and duration. Learners see only labs assigned to them; administrators see the labs of their own organisation.

workspaceId.description: Restrict the list to one workspace.

tools.name: skilltrack_list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions
tools.description: List lab sessions visible to this user with their status and remaining time. Learners see only their own sessions; administrators see the sessions of their own organisation. Connection details and machine addresses are never returned.

live.description: Only sessions that are still running (default true).

workspaceId.description: Restrict the list to one workspace.

tools.name: skilltrack_get_session
tools.title: Get session status
tools.description: Return the live status of one SkillTrack Labs session: lifecycle state, connection state, machine readiness and minutes remaining. Access is refused unless the session belongs to this user, or to an administrator of the same organisation.

tools.name: skilltrack_start_lab
tools.title: Start lab
tools.description: Start a SkillTrack Labs lab for the signed-in user and return the resulting session. Repeating the call for a lab that is already running returns the existing session instead of a second machine. The lab must be published and assigned to the caller.

tools.name: skilltrack_stop_lab
tools.title: Stop lab
tools.description: Stop a running SkillTrack Labs session, disconnect its remote desktop and release the machine. This ends the learner's work immediately and cannot be undone.

tools.name: skilltrack_extend_session
tools.title: Extend session
tools.description: Extend a running SkillTrack Labs session by a number of minutes, up to the extension allowance configured for its lab. Refused for sessions the caller does not own and for sessions that have already ended.

minutes.description: Minutes to add; the server clamps this to the allowance.

tools.name: skilltrack_reconnect_session
tools.title: Reconnect remote desktop
tools.description: Re-establish the remote desktop connection for a running SkillTrack Labs session and report the connection state. Returns no tunnel URL, gateway address or machine address — the learner opens the desktop in the SkillTrack Labs app.
